PUCK_USB_PID.doc: USB product id, 0x1002: TinyUSB vendor-bulk interface identity

QUAT_PACKET_LEN.doc: pose payload bytes: seq + stamp + quat xyzw + gyro xyz

FRAME_VIDEO.doc: frame type 0x02: one blob fragment, VIDEO_HDR_LEN + <= VIDEO_FRAG_MAX B

FRAME_VIDEO_RECT.doc: frame type 0x05: dirty rectangles, 4 + VIDEO_RECT_LEN*rects B

FRAME_HDR_LEN.doc: frame header bytes: magic[2] + type + len[2]

FRAME_CRC_LEN.doc: frame CRC bytes, u16 LE, over type + len + payload

VIDEO_W.doc: stereo canvas width: two VIDEO_PANEL_W eyes side by side

VIDEO_PANEL_W.doc: one panel's width, i.e. one eye

VIDEO_HDR_LEN.doc: blob fragment header bytes: frame | frag | count | len, all u16 LE

VIDEO_FRAG_MAX.doc: blob bytes per fragment; VIDEO_HDR_LEN + this == FRAME_MAX_PAYLOAD

VIDEO_JPEG_MAX.doc: device assembly buffer, and the largest blob accepted

VIDEO_TILE.doc: dirty-rectangle grid in px, exactly the 4:2:0 MCU

VIDEO_RECTS_MAX.doc: a dirty bbox and a repair slice per eye, at most

VIDEO_RECT_LEN.doc: per-rectangle bytes: eye u8 | x,y,w,h u16 LE | jpeg_len u16 LE
